mentions.name: Tandem Reverse-Trike Halftrack
mentions.description: A tandem, reverse-trike halftrack built by combining the front end of an ATV with the back end of a snowmobile, replacing the snowmobile skis with wheels so it rides more like a motorcycle. It has extra length for a passenger and a cargo basket, is styled to look like it came out of Mad Max, and is intended for cruising around festivals while running an ad-hoc taxi service as a way of meeting people.
mentions.problem: Existing snowmobile ski-to-wheel conversions don't ride like a motorcycle and lack room for a passenger and cargo.
mentions.audience: The builder personally, plus festival-goers via the ad-hoc taxi service
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a tandem, reverse-trike halftrack, using the front end of an ATV and the back end of a snowmobile.
mentions.author: marssaxman
